definitions.explanation: The layer of fat that lies directly beneath the skin, as opposed to visceral fat surrounding internal organs. A common topic in discussions of diet and body composition.

examples.japanese: {皮下脂肪|ひかしぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧。
examples.english: To get rid of subcutaneous fat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{皮下脂肪|ひかしぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Women tend to have more subcutaneous fat than men.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{皮下脂肪|ひかしぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: To reduce subcutaneous fat around the stomach, both diet and exercise are important.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{皮下|ひか}→皮下：08743_hika⟧ (⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧ skin + ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧ under, "under the skin") and ⟦{脂肪|しぼう}→脂肪：03199_shibou⟧ (fat). {皮下脂肪|ひかしぼう} is commonly contrasted with ⟦{内臓脂肪|ないぞうしぼう}→内臓脂肪：08626_naizoushibou⟧ (visceral fat) in Japanese discussions of health and dieting. Subcutaneous fat is the type you can "pinch" and tends to accumulate around the hips, thighs, and upper arms.
